notes.title: 📰 Update – Rebranding of Interactions + Critical Fix
notes.content:
[p]You can now remove trees and other objects that unnecessarily take up space on the map – no miracles required. Starting today, many objects can simply be submerged. I’ve also added the ability to pick up animals as living creatures. Humans and the Avatar, as more sentient beings, are still not subject to our direct influence. This change is meant to make it easier to plan cities in areas occupied by animals.[/p][p]On top of that, there are several smaller fixes, but the most important one is:[/p][p]A [b]CRITICAL BUG[/b] that prevented trees from being properly removed (even after being hit by a meteor!), which could have caused performance drops. Everything now works as intended - smooth and trouble-free! This just shows how important it is to catch these issues at this stage of development, before the demo reaches you.[/p][p]As of now, everything points to a stable PC release of [b]Eden Universe[/b] on Steam later this year. I’m literally wrapping up the last details before the game heads into closed testing.
[/p][previewyoutube="9LMTsujunOo;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🌌 Eden Universe 🌌 - MAJOR CHANGES ✨
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings, Gods of Eden! ✨[/b][/p][p]It’s been a while since the last update on the game’s progress. But that doesn’t mean development has stopped - quite the opposite! Over the past few months, we’ve been working intensively on the project, and we already have a few things we’d like to share with you soon.[/p][p]Eden has changed and evolved a lot during this time. That’s why we’ll gradually start revealing selected elements - the ones truly worth your attention, without spoiling the storyline.


🚧 [b]Construction Panel Update (WIP)[/b] 🚧[/p][p]In [i]Eden Universe[/i], progress unfolds across the great Eras:
🔸 [b]Tribal Era[/b]
🔸 [b]Settler Era[/b]
🔸 [b]Colonial Era[/b]
🔸 [b]Golden Era[/b] ✨[/p][p]Each Era brings [b]new opportunities[/b] for building and development, empowering our followers to thrive 🛠️🌿. As the metropolis blossoms, it shines with splendor ✨ — drawing the gaze of nearby settlements 🏘️. Through this, we expand our influence [b]without the need for armies[/b] ⚔️ or costly divine powers 🔮.[/p][p]With every step forward, the city’s [b]prestige[/b] grows 🏛️, and so too does the happiness of its inhabitants 😊, who live under our divine light ☀️.[/p][p]But take heed… rapid growth never goes unseen 👁️.
The gods of Eden stir with envy 😠, their watchful eyes turning toward our rising power...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/2a0ded4af2528a754297318465243d8587a34170.png"][/img]
==================================================

[b]🔥 A new divine power in Eden Universe! ⛏️✨[/b][/p][p]Players, as almighty Gods, can now create boulders, which then, under the influence of the meteorite miracle ☄️, undergo immense pressure, leading to the formation of valuable ores and gemstones. 💎⛏️ But this is only the beginning of the divine process![/p][p]To extract the hidden treasures within the rock, it must first be heated 🔥 and then split apart by the lightning miracle ⚡⚡. Beware! A blazing boulder has a small chance of causing a fire 🔥🔥.[/p][p]With this mechanic, you can obtain:[/p][p]🔴 Mercury Ore[/p][p]⚪ Tin Ore[/p][p]🟠 Copper Ore[/p][p]⚫ Iron Ore[/p][p]🟡 Gold Ore[/p][p]💎 Gemstones[/p][p]🔷 Diamonds[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/a7dd4f77f74d771f1f8b1e5a713f60211eaff35a.png"][/img]
==================================================

🔹 [b]Test Map[/b] – I’m sure you already recognize it. It’s a great playground where I can throw in literally everything and see how it works.[/p][p]🔹 [b]New Lighting System[/b] 💡 – it has finally arrived in Eden! It works similarly to Talus Odyssey but also takes dynamic changes in the environment into account.
What does that mean? If new flammable objects appear, the script will detect them and then “freeze” itself so it doesn’t put unnecessary strain on the game. The effect looks great, though admittedly, it might still be a little too strong 🔥🌳.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Pixel-art Font[/b] ✍️ – fully supported, with no blurring effect!
🔹 [b]Bug Fixes[/b] 🛠️ – interface, saving, and loading all work properly now.[/p][p]👉 [b]What’s next?[/b]
I’m slowly putting everything together, and soon we’ll begin testing. We’ll start small – focusing on the basics to catch as many bugs as possible in the early stages, before moving on to the actual storyline.[/p][p]Testing will be done in phases.
💭 If I push hard enough, by the end of the year everyone should have the chance to play the [b]Eden Universe demo[/b].
This demo will serve as a solid foundation for what you’ve all been waiting for…[/p][p]🌟 [b]Early Access![/b] 🌟
With your help, I hope we can polish as much as possible before the official Early Access launch, including balancing the gameplay of the first two Ages.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/b977fa17459fcdc08564e574728b5b1523f2e84b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/6d7f515aa4927077bf9a76767396c01fbddf294e.png"][/img]==================================================
A flashlight has been attached to the mouse system, which lights up the surrounding area at night – I seriously wondered whether Eden really needs this, but since the classic had it… I think we all know the answer.

Another new feature is descriptions for everything you hover your hand over. Everything in Eden has a description of what it is, and sometimes an extra window pops up with details or hints. Of course, these are things like:

Stone
LMB (Left Mouse Button) Pick up

When the stone is glowing:

Glowing Stone
LMB Pick up
May cause fire!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/f5c40187c75fe24d0ebc0c19fbd0ba93702b57e3.png"][/img]A small thing, but it will definitely help new players understand how the game works. There will be more changes, but that’s not the focus today. I want to test stability, balance, and critical bugs before the game goes broader with the storyline. So this will be a sandbox test. Lots to play with and try to break the game. Only once the balance is polished and the bugs fixed will we release another test version to a wider audience.

I will need a control group for closed testing of Eden Universe. Anyone interested should email me explaining why you want to test Eden Universe:

Email title: \[EDEN Tester First Name Last Name or Nickname]
Content: Tell me something about yourself and why you want to be in the closed control group.
📧 [url="https://haxogamestudios@gmail.com"]haxogamestudios@gmail.com[/url]
 ⚠️ NOTE: These first tests are confidential, meaning they are covered by an NDA.

==================================================

🌌 Eden Universe 🌌 - Official OST🎶 [/p][p] [/p][p]I’d like to invite you to listen to the full Eden Universe soundtrack playlist. Starting from yesterday, new tracks will be unveiled each day, slowly building a complete journey through our world. 🎶 [/p][p] [/p][p]I hope you’ll discover the same sense of nostalgia that I feel while working on Eden Universe. ✨

[url="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaEA2g3raqMqCLbj2s5Ln2XEFEqE3_W2j"]Eden Universe - OST[/url]


A large part of the information has been published on our Discord. If you want to stay up to date and have a real impact on the development of the game, I encourage you to join our Discord server.

💬Our Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/djHwrspu9x"]Discrord[/url]

[/p]

notes.title: Thank you for your support so far!
notes.content:
I would like to announce that since the trailer's release, around 500 new people have added our game, Eden Universe, to their wishlists. For some, it might seem little, for others, quite a lot - for me personally, it's proof that what we are creating is moving in the right direction. You have decided that Eden Universe is worth adding to your wishlists, for which I am sincerely grateful!

I know how much this title means to true fans of the god-game genre. I grew up playing one of these productions and create my own work with sentiment. However, I assure you that it will not lack the old - nostalgic elements enriched with new - properly implemented solutions. The game features a simple and enjoyable control system based on just a few keys + a mouse.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to discuss them in our community hub:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1964650/discussions/]Eden Universe feedback[/url]

If you haven't had the chance to see the latest trailer of our game yet, I invite you to do so here:

[previewyoutube=H0-fiVTsRtI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Great Anticipation: The Eden Universe Trailer Premieres on June 1, 2024!
notes.content:
For all fans of simulation games, particularly "God Games," an exceptional moment is approaching! On June 1, 2024, the long-awaited trailer for the game Eden Universe will finally be revealed. This project has been developed with immense passion and dedication, proving that dreams can indeed become a reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/b112c2dac185d4fe96f4ecd892391e8c0883a32a.png[/img]

Eden Universe is not just another game on the market. It is the fruit of years of hard work, creativity, and commitment. For the game's creator, making games is more than just a job – it's a true passion. From the very beginning, the goal was to create something unique that not only provides entertainment but also allows players to immerse themselves deeply in a fascinating, mysterious world.

The trailer, which will be released on June 1, aims to lift the veil of secrecy and give players a glimpse of what to expect from the full version of the game. It will be the first opportunity to see a sample of the game's world, appreciate its aesthetics, and gain insight into the gameplay we've prepared.

If you are a fan of simulation games, particularly "God Games," Eden Universe should be on your list of most anticipated titles. Get ready for an unforgettable journey into a world full of adventures, mysteries, and limitless possibilities. See you on June 1!

Stay tuned for the latest information about Eden Universe by following the game's official channels. This is just the beginning of an incredible adventure!

https://youtu.be/H0-fiVTsRtI

notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[h1]Merry Christmas![/h1]

Welcome!

Like every year, our team has some very cool traditions. So far, this has been done via our Facebook pages, Discord or YouTube channel. [b]This year we want to especially celebrate this day due to the fact that we are releasing our first game with the help of the Steam platform![/b] As it is [b]Christmas[/b], I would like to extend my warmest wishes on behalf of the entire Haxo Game Studios team. Every year we try to establish a Christmas theme in all our games and Eden Universe will be no exception in this aspect.

We are in the process of implementing several easter eggs referring to the holidays in the real world, in order to enjoy their atmosphere in our game as well. To this end, we encourage discussion in the Community Center of our game. You can send your suggestions, and we will be very happy to review them and select the best ones for implementation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/1c5107962963701f07390929b81c345e61734cb5.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome the gods of the Eden Universe pantheon!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome the gods of the Eden Universe pantheon![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/4b958f93ff989f4f2a6380600038cad642dff6d1.png[/img]

Here is the first developer entry of our game on the Steam platform. We're glad that you're here with us and support us with your presence. We have a lot of information for you regarding our game and are very interested in your opinions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/56e141d4af6d6995444f0a2037f1513566de3c7a.gif[/img]

As some of you may know Eden Universe has been in development for a year now. The official demo was supposed to be released as early as July 2022, but as new collaborations have been established, we decided to take the opportunity to add some new updates to game.
For this time we can confidently tell about some significant changes that have happened relative to the original concept of our small production.

[h2]Soundtrack (Aut. Michał Wilk-Krzeminski):[/h2]

[h3]EOST: Paradise[/h3]
[previewyoutube=B6uTAwbHa_k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]EOST: Vulcanos[/h3]
[previewyoutube=pgfgMI-ePTM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/9a1ba25c5172292cb7354375138dfed307e81ea3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/e08a568444b580a6d861f7c1e9c4233e57c7d577.png[/img]

[h2]News:[/h2]

- Possibility of building roads and residual terrain editing ( Proposed by the community [Aut. Mejkerrr] )
- Proposal to rob our warehouse by thieves ( Proposed by the community [Aut. Mejkerrr] )
- Concept of the appearance of so-called wild crops ( Proposed by the community [Aut. Mejkerrr] )
- Concept of other types of toys for the avatar ( Proposed by the community [Aut. lu-thien] )

- Sea encounters

- There is planned 12 raw materials for eden. At this point, the game's economy has been greatly expanded, and the gameplay itself is based on 72 raw materials needed to build, recruit troops and meet the needs of the inhabitants.

- Also planned is system of islands, where each land has a separate mission. Currently, we want the game world to be huge. Player gonna develop one homeland.  The campaign missions gonna be separate - additional island, where we solve the problems of other gods / inhabitants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42339453/099ab2546abbbdc1bfb8f1e98802f2ecbeef66bc.png[/img]

- 24 New buildings and 8 civilizations.  At this point there will be 10 civilizations, and each civilization will have more than 40 buildings + decorative structures.

- The game will include the ability to look into residents' homes, and production buildings.

- Graphic changes include not only the size of buildings, but also other objects. The maps themselves will be more stylistically consistent.

- The game will also feature new miracles:
* Miracle of freezing.
* Miracle of karma influence.
* Miracle of wind.
* Miracle of dispersion.
* Miracle of intimidation.
* Miracle of stopping time.
* Miracle of a snowstorm.
* others
